competences.description: Attacks the enemy target to put the enemy to sleep for 1 turn with a 10% chance and absorb the Attack Bar by 15% with a 30% chance. The damage increases accordingly to your Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

competences.description: Puts all enemies to sleep for 1 turn with a 60% chance and inflicts 2 Continuous Damage effects for 2 turns with a 60% chance.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Removes a random beneficial effect granted on an enemy at the start of your turn. Decreases the Attack Bar of the target whose beneficial effect was successfully removed by 30% and puts it to sleep for 1 turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.

effets.note: If beneficial effect has been successfully removed
